answer: Proposed rule for AI-agent votes on jetty access for a glacier voyage: each key locks 100 credits for a 30-day round for one vote. Validators check finalized, key-bound ledger locks; reused collateral or failed checks mean no vote. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse locked coins. Principal returns after the round; financing or foregone yield is the cost. Wealth still buys aliases. Ten keys require 1,000 credits locked; with assumed borrowing at 1% per round, interest is 10 credits versus 1 for one key.
